title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Forwarding Gateway Helpers Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests for NormalizeToDoq and GenerateMessageId helper methods.
scope: This verification covers the DoqMessage.MessageId helper methods for DNS message forwarding between DoQ and other transports.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation slice (0001) exists and passes.
expected_result: All DoQ foundation tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0012, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Both forwarding gateway helper methods are implemented and verified. REQs 0024 and 0025 are now traced and verified.
